names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14461, «Гермогена (Кадомцева), инокиня, прмц.», with the rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname — «Прмц. Гермогены (1942).» — so the surname is read from the name link, which is where this calendar keeps it. Measured against the gate’s own key function before the write: `fk.mjs` returns no holder for this form and none for the display name. THE BARE FORENAME WAS DELIBERATELY NOT STORED, this corpus holding many of that name and a bare form on a twentieth-century martyr being the fold failure BRIEF-ADDENDUM §2 describes.

death.note: The year the day line prints: «Прмц. Гермогены (1942).» No year of birth appears on either of the two pages that name her, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 мая ст. ст. — «Прмц. Гермогены (1942).»

attestations.note: The day’s eleventh entry, and only person of that line. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line carries a link to her name and none to a reading, and the name page behind it, 14461, prints the title «Гермогена (Кадомцева), инокиня, прмц.» and the line «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 28 мая» and nothing else at all. What it gives that the day line does not is the surname and the degree. `new-martyr` WAS WRITTEN AND THE GROUND IS READ: this calendar marks its own twentieth-century martyrs by giving them the general commemoration of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia on 26 января, and her page carries that day beside her own. That second day is the synaxis and not a feast of her own, so one row per church stands and she does not render on it. The day page prints thirteen hymns — four for the Rostov hierarchs as a company, two for Ignatius of Rostov under his own name, two for Nicetas of Chalcedon, two for Gerontius of Moscow and two for the Nicene icon — and none under her name. azbyka.ru was not read, and it is the source that would give her a life.
